title: Perl uninitialized value warning in arr2hash on empty tables
body:
When running mysqltuner.pl on a fresh MariaDB 10.11 instance with no user tables, I see:
Use of uninitialized value in array assignment at mysqltuner.pl line 412.
Can we add proper guarding?
